title: The Crab Derby, 2003
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Nineteenth annual. Two crabs again. And for the first time, a cup of coffee drawn on the flyer.

panels.composition: The shack. The twenty. The counter. GULLY. WOOD drawing.

balloons.text: You're a coffee place now. The flyer should know.

image.prompt: a young man drawing a crab flyer on a shack counter with a chrome espresso machine behind him, a friend in an apron holding out a twenty, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The flyer: the two crabs, and between them a steaming cup, drawn with the same absurd care as the crabs.
props: flyer with two crabs and a cup

image.prompt: close-up of a hand-drawn flyer showing two meticulously hatched crabs with a steaming coffee cup drawn between them

panels.composition: Gully, looking at it a long time.

balloons.text: The cup's better than the crabs.

image.prompt: a young man in an apron studying a flyer closely and looking pleased

panels.composition: Six flyers. The sixth has a cup. Gully pinning it. The machine gleaming behind.

image.prompt: six crab flyers in a row on a shingle wall, the newest with a coffee cup between its crabs, a chrome espresso machine gleaming inside the doorway, black and white, no words
